title: async / await

blocks.md:
## Sugar over promises

An `async function` always returns a Promise. `await` pauses **that** function until the promise settles. Other JavaScript on the page can still run. The operating system is not frozen.

The fox can `await` a wait on the field while the desk still lights other lamps. Only the fox’s function is paused. When the promise settles, that function continues with the value.

choices.md: Only the async function you are in

blocks.explainMd: Only the async function waits. Other work on the page can still run.

blocks.promptMd: > `async function label()` returns `"keyed"` after `await Promise.resolve()`. Print it.

hintLadder.md: `label` must be `async` so you can `await` inside it.
Await a resolved promise, then return the word `keyed`.
Print the returned value from `then`, and export `label`.
